items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: Because Cozy Coles had a band and they had him back there with horns... But that didn't move me too much.

ctx.x: Once he took one trombone player with him, and the trombone player got very inebriated and had one of those big, pretty naps. Had one of those beautiful lamps, he had it in his pants, taking it out. And his excuse was, 'Oh, I was drunk, I didn't know what I was doing.' And Lucky said, yes, but I was aware. It's unfortunate. Most unfortunate. That was the end of that.

And Lucky's words for a musician, he'd call you 'Demon,' 'hello, Demon.' Because that's another way to call them so and so and his jazz demons. One of these, they had (inaudible) little devils--imps, behind the music. Because Cozy Coles had a band and they had him back there with horns and they had (inaudible), and had imps all around him. But that didn't move me too much.
